text: Final categorization: EXCLUDED (Justification: The paper's primary focus is on farmland protection zoning and spatial optimization, not on predicting or simulating future land use land cover (LULC) change. The "scenarios" refer to different irrigation efficiency conditions used to assess static production potential, not to alternative future LULC trajectories. The model allocates existing farmland for protection based on 2015 data, rather than projecting how LULC will change over time. It fails the core inclusion criterion that the primary focus must be LULC prediction/simulation.)
